chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Sama'ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Mithami from Aban ibn 'Uthman from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah and Abu al-'Abbas, both said: He said:
Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said: 'It is not permissible for a man to go to bed with his wife on Wednesday night.'

key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِامْرَأَةٍ: to enter with a woman (marital intimacy)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marital intimacy on Wednesday night in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes a specific time-based dislike (karaha) for marital intimacy on Wednesday night, reflecting the broader Shia tradition of observing auspicious and inauspicious times for various acts of worship and daily life. The chain of narration highlights the transmission of this ruling through prominent figures like Aban ibn Uthman and Ubayd ibn Zurara, anchoring it within the early Imami scholarly lineage. While not a strict prohibition, it serves as a recommended precaution (ihtiyat) for believers seeking to align their personal lives with spiritual rhythms.

en.sarwar: 3. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Sama‘ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Mithamiy from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah and abu al-‘Abbas who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘A man must not go to bed with a woman in a Wednesday night.’”
